acceptanceCriteria: A quote inside a regex literal never opens a string state in blankCode
A slash after a value stays division
ts/lint counts a binding used after a regex literal holding a quote
diagnosis: Reproduced: ts/lint reports a binding unused when a regex literal holding a quote precedes its only use, e.g. assert.match(x, /a"/, 'msg'). Root cause: blankCode has no regex-literal mode, so the quote inside the regex opens a string state that blanks real code until a matching quote; unusedBindingFindings counts uses over that blanked text. Fix: blankCode skips regex literals (a slash after an operator, opener or keyword, closed on the same line, character classes honoured), blanking the body; anything ambiguous stays division.
